ignoreValues.reason: user specified exact px values in the build brief (.foot 12px, .eyebrow/.foot 11px at <=420px, .boot p 12.5px); these are editorial caption/meter sizes, not body copy
brief pins the palette verbatim: 'Keep the light, off-white editorial look: paper #f2f0ec, near-black ink #0d0c0b'. Impeccable's own rule is that a pinned brief outranks a saturated-pattern warning.

no raster is buried: .grain is procedural SVG noise at .13 with mix-blend-mode:multiply (visible anti-banding, not a compliance token), and the wash it sits over is a scrubbed video that is the page's entire subject. Veil alphas are specified in the brief and drop to .12 across the middle 22-78% precisely so the footage reads.
